answer: One workable design: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because voyage only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. In practice river is enforced by the ledger itself: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any dune approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
